schema:
id: int64 not null
unsigned: uint64
amount: decimal128(20, 4)
profile: struct<label: string not null, score: float>
  child 0, label: string not null
  child 1, score: float
items: list<element: int32>
  child 0, element: int32
lookup: map<int32, string ('lookup')>
  child 0, lookup: struct<key: int32 not null, value: string> not null
      child 0, key: int32 not null
      child 1, value: string
matrix: list<element: list<element: int64>>
  child 0, element: list<element: int64>
      child 0, element: int64
stamp: timestamp[ns, tz=UTC]
local: timestamp[us]
day: date32[day]
clock: time64[ns]
bytes: fixed_size_binary[3]
small: int8
